title: Create positive habits for success. #Shorts
description:
Hello, my friends, I am Vahid Akfari and I am glad that I can be of service to you once again. Today I want to talk about a simple way to achieve our goal. We all desire to attain the fulfillment of my divine will.

And I voted more easily. But you can still follow our journey. So that we can better understand this issue and better create and instill this habit in ourselves.
